note: City of Houghton municipal RV park on the Portage Waterway at 1100 W Lakeshore Drive, paved sites. Self-contained units only: no pop-ups or tents, as there is no bathroom or shower building; no generators. Next to Ray Kestner Waterfront Park (beach, fishing piers, boat launch), at the west end of the four-mile waterfront trail to downtown. GPS may misroute: follow the highway signs and don't turn onto Houghton Canal Road. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 25 paved full hook-up sites (20/30/50 amp), no restrooms or showers (self-contained only), phone-only booking at 906-482-8745 opening April 30 for daily stays, $60/night daily ($55 weekly, $50 monthly), and a May 1, 2026 opening. Recorded the opening date and booking detail; fee note now records the nonrefundable deposit that the city says is not credited to the camping fee. Note cleaned of hookups, booking and season (and its unposted 'to October' close); WiFi left in facilities since the page is silent.
flags: Fee read: the city says each reservation's nonrefundable deposit 'will not be credited to your camping fee' - $60 on a one-night stay - which may make a daily night cost $120 rather than $60 (https://www.cityofhoughton.com/rv-park/, read 2026-10-22). Local campground, so the price gate does not apply.
